body:
Intimate Methallylescaline Flipping
It should be noted that I had taken MDMA two weeks prior to this experience, and had never taken MAL before. I do not take any prescription drugs, however I had insufflated a small amount of cocaine an hour prior to the initial dosing of MAL.
4:00 pm- I arrive at my best friends place, we are alone though we are planning to see his father later that evening. It's a very welcoming home, and his family is generous enough to permit us to have psychedelic experiences here. My friend doesn't want to try MAL on today, as he likes to take longer breaks between experiences than I do and had consumed LSD a week prior.
4:15- I scale 30 mg of pure methallylescaline HCl, dissolve it in a small amount of water, and drink it. We then go into a theatre room and watch the movie Paprika.
5:00- The come up is very gentle for me. Forty five minutes after dosing the MAL I begin to experience a slight 'breathing' of the objects around the theatre room (not dramatic at all though, much less so than psilocin), and begin to feel the onset of what I would compare to a lower dose of MDMA.
5:50- After the movie is done, we go outside to swim. Still at a plus one, the coloration of the trees around the pool begin to shift, and the light on the water is particularly eye catching.
My friends father arrives and comes out to talk with us while we are swimming. We discuss going out together the next day, and also make plans to eat later that evening. I recommended my friend take some MDMA, and he agrees, on the condition that I dose as well.
6:20- I measure 100 mg MDMA for myself, and 150 for my friend. As I am scaling, my whole torso is gently shaking. After consuming the Molly, my friend offers me a dab of sativa hash wax, which I reluctantly oblige. I only take one, as I don't normally use cannabis and have a very low tolerance, and my friend takes a few, most likely having consumed some earlier that day as well.
6:40- The cannabis muddies my perception greatly. We go back outside, and I begin to dissociate. Words became much quieter, and I lost focus and interest in the conversation. Communication becomes challenging, and would remain so for another hour until the cannabis wore off.
7:00- We prepare some burgers, despite a lack of hunger, so that my friend's father could eat. My friend tells his dad that we are rolling, and also informs him of me taking 'mescaline' (we didn't want to frighten him with the idea of an RC). Thus begins a long and familial conversation amongst us three at a dinner table. I fail to participate much in the conversation due to my becoming disoriented and detached, but we talked a lot about responsible drug consumption, making the most out of our younger years and having fun while we could, girls, etc. Throughout the discussion I see hiccups in movement, like rapid fire déjà vu, eg. someone bobbing their head really quickly five times in a second. Another very pronounced effect was a flickering of my vision-like vision when blacking out, only as if it was being turned off and on again repeatedly. Despite this effect, I wasn't nervous about blacking out because nothing other than the visual aspect was happening that would suggest that I was. We later make the transition to listening to music, and eventually retire back to the theatre room, the father returning to work on some things on his computer.
8:30- We put on the film Inherent Vice, though I pay virtually no attention to it. I spend this time in my thoughts, and think about a few people and how I feel about them. The visual effects have settled down at this point.
After the movie, we go to bed, where I remain awake and mentally active until 4 am. The following morning I am exhausted and hungry, but have a pleasant after glow.
MAL was an interesting and peaceful experience, but I will do it differently the next time I try it. MDMA was a natural feeling accompaniment, but the cannabis made for a poor mix. I would also like to try a slightly heavier dose of MAL; most likely 45 mg will be the next step, which when I do, if I take MDMA I will keep the dose in the same range, 80-100 mg.
